fields.description: State-buffer flag byte at offset +0x00; gates progress into FUN_08038570
fields.evidence: FUN_08037ef8 tests *param_1 (buffer byte +0x00): nonzero proceeds to FUN_08038570(param_1,param_2,*param_2,0); baseline 0x15 keeps that path live.
fields.name: status_byte_0

fields.description: State-buffer byte at offset +0x01, copied from record table byte +0x5b
fields.evidence: FUN_0803884c writes param_1+1 from table byte *(iVar2+0x5b) during state init; baseline 0x62 is the live copied value.
fields.name: param_copy_1

fields.description: Table u16 at record offset +2 (0x84-stride record table family)
fields.evidence: FUN_08000358 indexes a 0x84-stride record table by (param_1&0xff) and loads u16 at rec+2 into render state; baseline 0x4009.
fields.name: table_u16_02

fields.description: Table u16 at record offset +4 (0x84-stride record table family)
fields.evidence: FUN_08000358 loads u16 at rec+4 from the same 0x84-stride table (and rec+4<<8 into display state); baseline 0x3fc0.
fields.name: table_u16_04

fields.description: Repeated table dword 0x01400300, first of four identical occurrences
fields.evidence: FUN_0800e524 reads a u32 link field at struct offset +8 when dispatching indexed records; baseline dword 0x01400300 repeats at file offsets 0x08/0x10/0x14/0x1c.
fields.name: table_u32_08

fields.description: Paired u16 at offset +0x0c (low byte 0xaa alternating-bits marker)
fields.evidence: FUN_08038570 reads *(short*)(param_2+0x0c) when computing the entity update term; baseline 0x00aa.
fields.name: pair_a_0c

fields.description: Object state byte at +0x12; nonzero gates the FUN_080381c4 path
fields.evidence: FUN_08037ef8 branches on param_1[0x12] (zero skips FUN_080381c4) and FUN_080388a4 re-tests (char*)(param_2+0x12); baseline 0x40.
fields.name: obj_state_12

fields.description: Object flag byte at +0x13 written through button-mask AND combination
fields.evidence: FUN_08037ef8 reads (char*)(param_2+0x13) to select the reset path, and FUN_0800833c writes rec+0x13 as param_4 masked with 0xfb/0xf7/0xfe/0xfd combos; baseline 0x01.
fields.name: obj_flag_13

fields.description: Per-tick copy slot at +0x14, refreshed from byte +0x48
fields.evidence: FUN_080388a4 copies param_1[0x14]=param_1[0x48] every tick and separately writes [0x14]=-1 on the select path; baseline live value 0x00.
fields.name: copy_slot_14

fields.description: Select-path live flag at +0x17, set to 1 when chosen
fields.evidence: FUN_080388a4 stores param_1[0x17]=1 on the bVar1==1 select path (else 0); baseline 0x01 matches the selected state.
fields.name: live_flag_17

fields.evidence: FUN_08037ef8 loads cVar1=param_1[0x15] and stores back cVar1-1 each tick (wrapping u8 countdown); baseline 0x03.
fields.name: state_timer_15

fields.evidence: FUN_08003908 loops 0x30 records testing *(ushort*)(rec+0x1c)&0x8000 to dispatch FUN_0800388c; baseline 0x0300 (bit15 clear).
fields.name: table_u16_1c

fields.description: Object state byte at +0x1e, cleared on the reset path
fields.evidence: FUN_080388a4 writes param_1[0x1e]=0 on the state-reset path (with [0x1f]); baseline live value 0x40.
fields.name: obj_state_1e

fields.description: Object state byte at +0x1f, cleared on the reset path
fields.evidence: FUN_080388a4 writes param_1[0x1f]=0 on the state-reset path (with [0x1e]); baseline live value 0x01, mirroring the [0x17]=1 live pattern.
fields.name: obj_state_1f

fields.description: Pending-accumulation counter at +0x22, folded into the +0x44 accumulator
fields.evidence: FUN_080383f4 reads *(short*)(param_1+0x22) nonzero-gated, adds it into *(short*)(param_1+0x44), then zeroes +0x22 (FUN_08037e94/FUN_08037f8c/FUN_080388a4 also zero it); baseline 0x004e pending.
fields.name: state_counter_22

fields.description: Decrementing short countdown at +0x24; at zero triggers FUN_08037f8c
fields.evidence: FUN_08037ef8 loads *(short*)(param_1+0x24), decrements, and on reaching zero calls FUN_08037f8c(param_1,param_2,1); baseline 0xfbff.
fields.name: state_counter_24

fields.evidence: FUN_080381c4 reads and increments *(ushort*)(param_1+0x26) each cycle (bounded by table byte +0x11); FUN_08037f8c/FUN_080388a4 zero +0x26 on reset paths; baseline 0xFF00 near wrap.
fields.name: cycle_counter_26
